name: banking77_intents_v2
instructions:
You are a banking support chatbot intent classifier. Classify the following customer message into one of 77 specific banking intents.

Key distinctions:
- declined_card_payment: Card purchases that were declined (e.g., "card declined at shop")
- declined_transfer: Bank transfers that were declined
- pending_transfer: A specific transfer that is pending or has been waiting
- transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take
- card_arrival: Card hasn't come / tracking number requests
- card_delivery_estimate: How long delivery takes / when will it come / express delivery
- card_payment_not_recognised: Unrecognized transactions on statement
- extra_charge_on_statement: Unexpected charges / fees on statement
- top_up_failed: Top-up attempt failed
- top_up_reverted: Top-up was reversed back
- topping_up_by_card: Questions about the process of topping up with a card
- card_not_working: General card not working issues (not specific to ATM)
- declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM withdrawal was declined
- atm_support: General ATM issues / location questions

Be precise and pick the most specific intent that matches the customer's request.
description: Classify banking support messages into 77 intents - refined with key distinctions
